book.animusnv.guide.blocks.antilife.deca:
When any AntiLife block is broken, it triggers a decay chain reaction:

- All adjacent AntiLife blocks begin decaying

- Decay spreads outward to connected AntiLife

- Decayed blocks are removed entirely\
\
This prevents infinite expansion and allows cleanup of corrupted areas.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Blocks tagged animusnv:disallow_antilife are protected from conversion.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.antilife.desc: A corrupting substance that consumes blocks and spreads like plague.
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.antilife.intr:
A corrupting substance that spreads like a plague, consuming all blocks of a specific type. You create it using the [#](8B0000)Sigil of Consumption[#]().\
\
[#](4A0080)AntiLife is the antithesis of creation, matter unmade, given form and purpose by your will alone.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.antilife.name: AntiLife
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.antilife.spre:
AntiLife spreads to adjacent blocks of the same type as the original converted block.\
\
Each spread consumes [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from the caster who created it (configurable).\
\
The corruption reaches up to 8 blocks from its origin, though this range can be configured through the [#](8B0000)Sigil of Consumption[#]().
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.antilife_flui:
When AntiLife fluid touches blocks, it converts them to [#](8B0000)AntiLife blocks[#](), which continue to spread the corruption.\
\
When AntiLife fluid contacts [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() fluid, it spreads as fluid instead of converting to blocks, rapidly corrupting large volumes.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Handle with extreme care. This fluid is not easily contained once released.[#]()

Place [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() fluid and strike it with lightning. Use a [#](8B0000)Lightning Rod[#]() or the [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Storm[#]() to call down the bolt.\
\
The Essentia Vitae instantly transforms into AntiLife fluid, which:

- Spreads like water

- Consumes blocks it touches

- Cannot be reversed

- Can be collected in buckets
A corrupting liquid born when lightning strikes Essentia Vitae.

A corrupting liquid that spreads destruction. [#](8B0000)AntiLife fluid[#]() is created when lightning strikes [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#](), transforming it into a dark, consuming force.\
\
[#](4A0080)Where Essentia Vitae carries the spark of life, this fluid carries its negation, a tide of unmaking.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.blood_trees.c:
The heart of every blood tree. When active (right-click to toggle), the core automatically spreads blood trees in the surrounding area.\
\
An active core:

- Searches for grass or dirt nearby

- Places Blood Saplings

- Instantly grows them into trees

- Creates a blood forest over time
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.blood_trees.d: Trees born of sacrifice, crowned with spreading Blood Cores.
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.blood_trees.g:
Plant a [#](8B0000)Blood Sapling[#]() and wait for it to grow, or hasten the process with bonemeal. The tree grows 4-6 blocks tall.\
\
The resulting structure consists of:

- [#](8B0000)Blood Wood[#]() trunk

- [#](8B0000)Blood Leaves[#]() canopy

- [#](8B0000)Blood Core[#]() at the apex\
\
Harvest the wood for building materials. See the Decorative Blocks entry for crafting options.
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.blood_trees.i:
Trees infused with Vitaemancy. [#](8B0000)Blood Saplings[#]() grow into unique trees topped with a [#](8B0000)Blood Core[#]() that can spread to create entire blood forests.\
\
[#](4A0080)Life forced into unnatural growth. The wood remembers the sacrifice that birthed it, and seeks to propagate that memory.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.blood_trees.t:
[#](2E8B57)You can apply bonemeal to active cores to trigger immediate spreading.[#]()\
\
[#](8B0000)Blood Leaves[#]() drop Blood Saplings when broken, just like normal trees.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Combine with tree farms for automated blood wood production.[#]()\
\
[#](4A0080)Let the blood forest grow.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.crystallized_: Solidified Spiritus, an alternate CRYSTAL capstone for the Transcendent Ara Vitae.

Solidified [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() in crystalline form. This decorative pillar serves as a valid [#](B8860B)CRYSTAL[#]() capstone for the [#](B8860B)Transcendent[#]() Ara Vitae.\
\
Cut it from a [#](4A0080)Crystal Cluster[#]() on a stonecutter, or cut it back again if you prefer the other shape.\
\
[#](4A0080)Will made manifest. Spiritus compressed beyond the threshold of dissolution, locked into permanent physical form.[#]()

The Crystallized Spiritus Block functions as a [#](B8860B)CRYSTAL[#]() block for altar construction. It can stand in for the crystal cluster capstones on the highest tier [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]().\
\
See the Scriptura Vitae for full altar construction details.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Beyond its functional role, the block radiates a faint demonic light, making it a striking addition to any ritual chamber.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.blocks.decorative_bl:
Standard wood recipes apply:

- Log -> 4 Planks

- 6 Planks -> 4 Stairs

- 3 Planks -> 6 Slabs

- 4 Planks + 2 Sticks -> 3 Fences

- 2 Planks + 4 Sticks -> 1 Gate\
\
All Blood Wood blocks work with standard wood recipes and can be used as fuel.\
\
[#](4A0080)Build your dark empire in crimson.[#]()
Crimson building materials crafted from Blood Wood.

[#](8B0000)Blood Wood[#]() harvested from Blood Trees can be processed into a variety of decorative building blocks. The crimson wood makes for striking architectural accents.\
\
[#](4A0080)Every plank remembers the tree it came from, and the sacrifice that grew it.[#]()

Use an axe on [#](8B0000)Blood Wood[#]() logs to strip the bark, revealing a smoother texture.\
\
Craft Blood Wood logs into [#](8B0000)Planks[#]() (4 planks per log). These planks serve as the base for all other decorative variants:

- [#](8B0000)Blood Wood Stairs[#](): 6 planks in a stair pattern

- [#](8B0000)Blood Wood Slabs[#](): 3 planks in a row

- [#](8B0000)Blood Wood Fence[#](): planks and sticks

- [#](8B0000)Blood Wood Fence Gate[#](): sticks and planks
Living Terra can be employed for:

- Decorative purposes

- Advanced rituals

- Crafting components

- Environmental effects\
\
[#](4A0080)The essence of life itself, contained. Handle it with the reverence such power demands.[#]()
A mystical fluid infused with vital energy, the antithesis of AntiLife.

A mystical fluid infused with Essentia Vitae. [#](8B0000)Living Terra[#]() is a rare liquid created through specialized processes, radiating with vital energy.\
\
[#](4A0080)Where AntiLife carries the negation of existence, Living Terra pulses with its affirmation, raw potential given liquid form.[#]()

Living Terra exhibits unique properties:

- Flows like water

- Glows with inner light

- Can be collected in buckets

- Used in advanced Vitaemancy\
\
This fluid represents the positive aspect of life force, contrasting sharply with the corruption of [#](8B0000)AntiLife[#]().

book.animusnv.guide.blocks.willful_stone:
The base [#](8B0000)Willful Stone[#]() is forged in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() from stone, a [#](8B0000)Tabula Robur[#](), and redstone dust. The Forge yields [#](B8860B)4 blocks[#]() per craft.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Search for Willful Stone in JEI to see the exact recipe.[#]()
Spiritus-infused decorative stone in sixteen colours.

Once you have the base grey [#](8B0000)Willful Stone[#](), surround any dye with eight Willful Stones in a crafting table to produce [#](B8860B)8 coloured variants[#](). All sixteen dye colours are supported.\
\
[#](2E8B57)You can re-dye Willful Stone of any colour. Simply use a different dye in the same 8-around-1 pattern.[#]()

Stone saturated with [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() takes on a strange, almost luminous quality, as though the demonic energy has fused with the mineral itself. [#](8B0000)Willful Stone[#]() is a decorative building material prized by Vitaemancers who wish their sanctums to reflect the power within.\
\
[#](4A0080)Once placed, Willful Stone can only be broken by the Vitaemancer who laid it. Others who attempt to mine it will find it unyielding. To grant an ally access, craft a [#](8B0000)Key of Binding[#]() and bind it to yourself, then share the key with your trusted companion.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.compatibility.arcane: A hybrid altar rune powered by Ars Nouveau Source magic.

The [#](8B0000)Arcane Rune[#]() bridges Ars Nouveau's Source magic with the altar system. Unlike traditional runes that provide static bonuses, this rune's power fluctuates based on its internal Source supply.\
\
[#](4A0080)Two disciplines of magic, woven into a single stone. The rune hums with dual resonance, blood and arcana intertwined.[#]()

To supply the Arcane Rune with Source:

- Use an Ars Nouveau [#](8B0000)Dominion Wand[#]() to link a Source Jar to the rune

- Source will automatically flow from the jar to the rune

- The rune can hold up to 1000 Source at a time\
\
This gives you precise control over which Source Jars supply your altar runes.

Place this rune in your [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() structure just like any other rune. It stores up to 1000 Source internally and can receive Source via Ars Nouveau's dominion wand linking system.\
\
Crafted using a [#](8B0000)Blank Rune[#]() at the center, any Stone in corners, [#](8B0000)Tabula Rasa[#]() top and bottom, and [#](8B0000)Source Gems[#]() on the sides.

The rune has two distinct states based on Source availability:\
\
[#](8B0000)Powered State[#]() (20 Source consumed every 10 seconds):

- Acts as a Speed Rune but 20%% faster

- Provides Dislocation Rune bonus\
\
[#](4A0080)Unpowered State[#]() (No Source available):

- Acts as a Speed Rune at 67.5%% effectiveness

- No Dislocation bonus

The Arcane Rune excels in hybrid builds:

- Provides superior altar speed when Source is plentiful

- Acts as a backup speed rune when Source runs out

- The dislocation bonus increases EV transfer rate\
\
[#](2E8B57)Consider the Source consumption rate (2 Source/second per rune) when planning your Source generation and storage. This rate is configurable.[#]()\
\
The rune emits a subtle glow (light level 7) when placed.
book.animusnv.guide.compatibility.ars_vi:
A full jar makes the ritual skip its turn entirely, drawing nothing, and EV is only taken for Source the jar actually accepts. The ritual also idles when your network cannot pay for a single point of Source.\
\
Every other Master Ritual Stone within 10 blocks [#](8B0000)doubles[#]() the price, so keep converters apart.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The exchange rate is shared with the Ritual of Source Vitaeum, and both directions pay it, so trading back and forth loses value.[#]()
Converts EV from your network into Source. Requires Ars Nouveau.

The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Ars Vitae[#]() pours life essence back into the arcane, drawing EV from the owner's network and filling a Source Jar with Ars Nouveau Source.\
\
It is the mirror of the [#](8B0000)Ritual of Source Vitaeum[#](), which runs the trade the other way.
[#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()

Place a [#](8B0000)Source Jar[#]() directly above the Master Ritual Stone. The EV comes from your network, so no altar is needed.\
\
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 10,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Exchange:[#]() 10 EV per Source (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Throughput:[#]() up to 100 Source every 2 seconds (configurable)
book.animusnv.guide.compatibility.blood_:
To create a Blood-Infused Spellbook:

- Obtain any [#](8B0000)Spellbook[#]() from Iron's Spells

- Place the spellbook in the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]()

- Ensure the altar has [#](8B0000)5,000 EV[#]() stored

- Wait for the altar to complete the infusion\
\
The spellbook transforms into a [#](B8860B)Tier 1[#]() Blood-Infused Spellbook. [#](2E8B57)All your equipped spells are preserved during the transformation.[#]()
A spellbook enhanced through six tiers of blood infusion. Requires Iron's Spells.

The [#](8B0000)Blood-Infused Spellbook[#]() combines the power of Iron's Spells with the sacrificial arts. This hybrid tome can be progressively enhanced through [#](B8860B)six tiers[#]() of blood infusion, each granting new abilities at each step.\
\
[#](4A0080)Unlike common spellbooks, this tome grows stronger as you feed it Essentia Vitae at the Ara Vitae. It hungers, and it remembers.[#]()

Advanced tiers add EV cost reduction and lifesteal:\
\
[#](B8860B)Tier 4:[#]() Magus Orb, 50k EV. 10 slots, +200 mana, -10%% EV cost\
\
[#](B8860B)Tier 5:[#]() Dominus Orb, 100k EV. 11 slots, +250 mana, -20%% EV cost\
\
[#](B8860B)Tier 6:[#]() Divinus Orb, 175k EV. 12 slots, +300 mana, +5%% lifesteal

Each tier grants [#](8B0000)+50 Max Mana[#]() and additional spell slots:\
\
[#](B8860B)Tier 1:[#]() Created in the altar, 5k EV. 6 slots, +50 mana\
\
[#](B8860B)Tier 2:[#]() Discipulus Orb, 10k EV. 7 slots, +100 mana\
\
[#](B8860B)Tier 3:[#]() Veneficus Orb, 25k EV. 8 slots, +150 mana

To upgrade your spellbook to the next tier:

- Carry the required Orb of Vitae (or higher) in your inventory

- Ensure the altar has enough EV

- Right-click the altar while holding your Blood-Infused Spellbook\
\
The spellbook's tooltip shows your current tier, bonuses, and the requirements for the next upgrade.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Requires Iron's Spellbooks to be installed. The spellbook's rarity and enchantment glint change with each tier.[#]()

[#](2E8B57)Ideal for extended combat encounters, boss fights, and melee-focused builds.[#]()\

[#](4A0080)Blood fuels the arcane flow.[#]()

[#](2E8B57)Ideal for exploration, traversal, escaping dangerous situations, and stealth gameplay.[#]()\

[#](4A0080)One with the flow of mana.[#]()

book.animusnv.guide.compatibility.rune_u:
When the rune has mana in its internal buffer:\
\
[#](4A0080)Mana-Powered:[#]() Acceleration bonus speeds up altar crafting and EV generation. Consumes 10 mana per second while active.\
\
The acceleration effect stacks with other speed-enhancing runes, making high-tier crafting faster.

Supply mana to the rune using any Botania mechanism:

- Point a [#](8B0000)Mana Spreader[#]() at the rune

- Place it adjacent to a [#](8B0000)Mana Pool[#]()

- Use a [#](8B0000)Mana Tablet[#]() or other mana items\
\
[#](2E8B57)Consider the consumption rate (10 mana/second per rune) when planning your mana infrastructure for multiple runes. Requires Botania to be installed.[#]()

Crafted using a [#](8B0000)Blank Rune[#]() surrounded by Botania's [#](8B0000)Livingwood[#]() and [#](8B0000)Manasteel[#](). This creates a living altar rune that responds to mana flow.\
\
Place this rune in your [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() structure like any other rune. It stores mana internally and can be charged by pointing a Mana Spreader at it or placing it near a Mana Pool.
A hybrid altar rune powered by Botania mana. Requires Botania.

The [#](8B0000)Rune of Unleashed Nature[#]() is a hybrid altar component that channels Botania's mana into the altar system. Unlike the Arcane Rune which requires Source, this rune draws from an internal mana buffer refilled by any Botania mana-transferring mechanism.\
\
[#](4A0080)A living rune that responds to the flow of mana, nature's power harnessed for the blood mage's altar.[#]()

The Rune of Unleashed Nature provides bonuses even when empty:\
\
[#](8B0000)Always Active:[#]()

- Capacity Bonus: 135%% of a Capacity Rune's effect

- Orb Bonus: 67.5%% of a Rune of the Orb's effect, increasing Anima storage\
\
These passive bonuses make it valuable even without mana.
book.animusnv.guide.compatibility.sangui: Converts between Essentia Vitae and EvilCraft Blood.

The [#](8B0000)Sanguine Rectifier[#]() bridges the worlds of Vitaemancy and EvilCraft, converting between [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() and EvilCraft's [#](8B0000)Blood[#]() fluid.\
\
It operates in two modes simultaneously:\
\
[#](B8860B)EV → Blood:[#]() Insert a bound [#](8B0000)Orb of Vitae[#]() to drain EV from the bound network and produce Blood into adjacent fluid tanks.\
\
[#](B8860B)Blood → Altar:[#]() Pipe EvilCraft Blood into the rectifier and it transfers directly into the linked [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]().
Sanguine Rectifier
Sanguine Rectifier

Transfer rates scale with your altar's [#](8B0000)Speed Runes[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)EV → Blood:[#]() Base rate of 100 mB/tick, scaled by altar speed bonus.\
\
[#](B8860B)Blood → Altar:[#]() Transfers at [#](B8860B)4x[#]() the altar's normal rate (also scaled by speed runes).\
\
The conversion ratio between EV and Blood is 1:1 by default. All rates are configurable.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Crafted in the Tabula Vitae from a Cauldron, Dark Gem, Tabula Animata, and Bloodstained Glass.[#]()
Speed & Scaling

1. Place the rectifier within 10 blocks of an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](). It will automatically link on placement.\
\
2. Right-click a [#](B8860B)bound[#]() Orb of Vitae onto the rectifier. The orb will float above the block.\
\
3. Place fluid tanks (from any mod) adjacent to the rectifier to collect the produced Blood.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to re-scan for a nearby altar. Right-click with an empty hand to retrieve the orb.[#]()
Setup

Sanguine Scrolls consume more EV than normal spell casting:\
\
Base Cost: Mana cost x EV rate x 1.5 (default: 150 EV per mana point)\
\
Creation cost scales with spell rarity and level:

- Common: 5,000 EV x level

- Uncommon: 10,000 EV x level

- Rare: 25,000 EV x level

- Epic: 50,000 EV x level

- Legendary: 100,000 EV x level
EV Costs

To create a Sanguine Scroll:

- Obtain an [#](8B0000)Iron's Spells Scroll[#]() with the spell you want

- Place a [#](8B0000)NeoVitae Slate[#]() in your offhand

- Right-click an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() with the scroll

- The altar consumes EV and both items

- Receive a Sanguine Scroll with the spell bound\
\
[#](2E8B57)The slate tier determines scroll durability.[#]()
Creating Scrolls
Reusable spell scrolls powered by Essentia Vitae. Requires Iron's Spells.

[#](8B0000)Sanguine Scrolls[#]() are reusable spell scrolls that consume Essentia Vitae instead of being destroyed. Unlike regular scrolls, these blood-infused parchments can cast spells dozens or hundreds of times, limited only by their durability.\
\
[#](4A0080)A single spell, bound in blood. The scroll remembers the incantation and repeats it at the cost of your life force.[#]()
Sanguine Scrolls
Sanguine Scrolls

Sanguine Scrolls excel for:

- [#](8B0000)Emergency spells[#](): quick access without spellbooks

- [#](8B0000)Powerful spells[#](): cast legendary spells anytime

- [#](8B0000)EV-heavy builds[#](): convert excess EV to magic

- [#](8B0000)Backup casting[#](): when out of mana\
\
The 50%% EV premium is worth it for convenience and reliability. Scrolls work from any inventory slot.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Requires Iron's Spellbooks to be installed. Scrolls respect spell cooldowns.[#]()
Strategic Uses

Different slate types produce scrolls with varying durability:

- [#](B8860B)Tabula Rasa:[#]() 50 uses

- [#](B8860B)Tabula Robur:[#]() 100 uses

- [#](B8860B)Tabula Animata:[#]() 200 uses

- [#](B8860B)Tabula Spiritus:[#]() 400 uses

- [#](B8860B)Tabula Aetherea:[#]() 600 uses\
\
Choose based on how frequently you intend to use the spell.

book.animusnv.guide.imperfect_rituals.cl: An imperfect ritual that clears the weather.

An [#](4A0080)imperfect ritual[#]() that commands the weather to cease its fury. Rain and thunderstorms are banished, bringing roughly five minutes of clear skies.\
\
Place a [#](8B0000)Glowstone Block[#]() atop an [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Cost:[#]() 1,000 EV per activation\
\
The stone remains intact for reuse.

Right-click the [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]() to:

- Clear the weather instantly

- Stop all rain and thunder

- Maintain clear skies for approximately 5 minutes\
\
[#](2E8B57)Useful for stopping rain during important outdoor tasks, clearing thunderstorms for safety, and ensuring ideal conditions for surface work.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.imperfect_rituals.en: An imperfect ritual that raises all enchantment levels by one.

An [#](4A0080)imperfect ritual[#]() that pushes enchantments beyond their natural limits. Every enchantment on the held item gains one additional level, and the item is permanently marked to prevent further enhancement.\
\
Place an [#](8B0000)Amethyst Block[#]() atop an [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Cost:[#]() 5,000 EV per activation\
\
The stone remains intact for reuse.

Hold the item you wish to enhance in your main hand, then right-click the [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().

- All enchantments gain +1 level

- The item is marked as enhanced

- Items can only be enhanced once

- The enhancement mark cannot be removed through normal means\
\
[#](2E8B57)Enhanced items are ignored by the Ritual of Unmaking by default (configurable). Use the Imperfect Ritual of Reduction to reverse this process.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.imperfect_rituals.hu: An imperfect ritual that drains your food to near-starvation.

Right-click the [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]() to:

- Set your food level to 1

- Set your saturation to 10

- Hear an ominous sound as the rite completes\
\
Useful for preparing food-based buffs, testing hunger mechanics, or strategic hunger management.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Have food ready before activating. You will be on the verge of starvation.[#]()

An [#](4A0080)imperfect ritual[#]() that induces extreme hunger in the caster. Your food level plummets to near-starvation, leaving you ravenous.\
\
Place a [#](8B0000)Bone Block[#]() atop an [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Cost:[#]() 500 EV per activation\
\
The stone remains intact for reuse.
book.animusnv.guide.imperfect_rituals.ne: An imperfect ritual granting water breathing and Dolphin's Grace.

Right-click the [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]() to receive:

- [#](4A0080)Water Breathing[#]() for 15 minutes

- [#](4A0080)Dolphin's Grace[#]() for 15 minutes

- Both effects have no visible particles\
\
[#](2E8B57)Ideal for extended underwater exploration, ocean monument raids, underwater construction, and searching for shipwrecks.[#]()

An [#](4A0080)imperfect ritual[#]() that grants the blessing of the deep, allowing you to breathe underwater and swim with the grace of dolphins.\
\
Place a [#](8B0000)Prismarine Block[#]() atop an [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Cost:[#]() 2,000 EV per activation\
[#](B8860B)Duration:[#]() 15 minutes\
\
The stone remains intact for reuse.
book.animusnv.guide.imperfect_rituals.re: An imperfect ritual that lowers enchantment levels by one.

An [#](4A0080)imperfect ritual[#]() that reverses enchantment growth and strips the enhancement mark from items. All enchantments on the held item are reduced by one level.\
\
Place a [#](8B0000)Block of Quartz[#]() atop an [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Cost:[#]() 1,000 EV per activation\
\
The stone remains intact for reuse.

Hold the item you wish to reduce in your main hand, then right-click the [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().

- All enchantments lose 1 level

- The enhancement mark is removed

- Enchantments will not drop below level 1\
\
[#](2E8B57)This is the counterpart to the Imperfect Ritual of Enhancement. Use it to reverse an enhancement or carefully downgrade enchantments.[#]()
An imperfect ritual that removes anvil repair costs from items.

An [#](4A0080)imperfect ritual[#]() that strips away the accumulated repair cost from tools and weapons. The anvil penalty that makes items "Too Expensive" is wiped clean, rendering them repairable once more.\
\
Place a [#](8B0000)Bookshelf[#]() atop an [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Cost:[#]() 3,000 EV per activation\
\
The stone remains intact for reuse.

Hold the item you wish to reset in your main hand, then right-click the [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().

- The item's repair cost tag is removed

- The item becomes fully repairable again

- Works on any item with accumulated anvil penalty\
\
[#](2E8B57)Invaluable for maintaining heavily-enchanted tools that have hit the "Too Expensive" ceiling. Keep your best gear in service indefinitely.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.imperfect_rituals.wa: An imperfect ritual granting the Obsidian Cloak damage reduction effect.

Right-click the [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]() to receive the [#](4A0080)Obsidian Cloak[#]() effect for 15 minutes.\
\
This effect dramatically reduces incoming damage, making you nearly invulnerable to most attacks.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Ideal for boss fights, dangerous exploration, PvP combat, and mining in hazardous areas. The darkness itself becomes your shield.[#]()

An [#](4A0080)imperfect ritual[#]() that channels the defensive power of the Warden itself, wrapping you in an impenetrable cloak of obsidian force.\
\
Place a [#](8B0000)Sculk Block[#]() atop an [#](8B0000)Imperfect Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Cost:[#]() 3,000 EV per activation\
[#](B8860B)Duration:[#]() 15 minutes\
\
The stone remains intact for reuse.
book.animusnv.guide.intro.name: Welcome
book.animusnv.guide.intro.welcome.descri: The opening pages of the Codex Animus, a companion to the Scriptura Vitae.
Welcome, practitioner of the sanguine arts.\
\
You hold the [#](4A0080)Codex Animus[#](), a companion volume to the [#](8B0000)Scriptura Vitae[#](). Where the Scriptura teaches the foundations of Vitaemancy, this codex delves into advanced techniques, experimental workings, and the integration of foreign magical disciplines into the blood mage's repertoire.\
\
Within these pages you will find darker applications of [#](4A0080)Anima[#](), rituals to summon and destroy, sigils to command the elements, and secrets of creating life from blood.
book.animusnv.guide.intro.welcome.name: Welcome
book.animusnv.guide.intro.welcome.organi:
The Codex Animus is organized into chapters:

- [#](8B0000)Blocks[#](): Unique materials, fluids, and flora

- [#](8B0000)Items[#](): Weapons, tools, and implements

- [#](8B0000)Sigils[#](): Portable instruments of Vitaemancy

- [#](8B0000)Rituals[#](): Ceremonial workings of power

- [#](8B0000)Imperfect Rituals[#](): Simpler rites for a single stone

- [#](8B0000)Compatibility[#](): Bridges to foreign magics
book.animusnv.guide.intro.welcome.prereq:
This tome assumes you have mastered the basics of Vitaemancy. You should be familiar with:

- The [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() and Essentia Vitae

- [#](8B0000)Orbs of Vitae[#]() and Anima binding

- Basic [#](8B0000)Rituals[#]() and Ritual Stones

- [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() and the Spiritus system\
\
If you are new to Vitaemancy, consult the [#](8B0000)Scriptura Vitae[#]() first. The knowledge within this codex builds upon that foundation.
book.animusnv.guide.items.activation_cry: A single-use activation crystal that shatters after one ritual activation.

A delicate activation crystal that shatters after a single use. Where a standard crystal endures, this fragile variant is consumed upon successful ritual activation , disposable power for those who need it only once.

The crystal must be bound to your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() before use. Right-click a Master Ritual Stone with a valid ritual pattern arranged around it.\
\
[#](8B0000)The crystal shatters upon successful activation.[#]()\
\
[#](2E8B57)Use this when you need a one-time ritual activation without investing in a permanent crystal.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.blood_apple.de: A crimson fruit that generates Essentia Vitae when consumed.
book.animusnv.guide.items.blood_apple.in: A crimson fruit infused with [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#](). Consuming this apple provides [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() to your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](), or to a nearby [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() if one stands within range.
book.animusnv.guide.items.blood_apple.ke:
If you carry a bound [#](8B0000)Key of Binding[#]() in your inventory or Curios slot while eating a Blood Apple (with no altar nearby), the EV is deposited into the key owner's [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() instead of your own.\
\
[#](2E8B57)This allows you to farm EV for other players. Simply carry their bound key and eat apples to fill their network remotely.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.blood_apple.us:
The apple restores 3 hunger with low saturation, and has a 75%% chance to inflict brief confusion.\
\
If an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() stands within an 11x21x11 area centered on you, the EV is deposited at 2x value into the altar. Otherwise, it flows directly into your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]().\
\
[#](4A0080)A bittersweet taste of power.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.fragment_heali: A permanently bound shard that passively regenerates your health.

A crystallized shard of restorative energy. Once acquired, this fragment binds permanently to your inventory and provides passive regeneration. It cannot be dropped, moved, or discarded. Only death will release its grip.

The fragment restores [#](2E8B57)1 HP every 10 seconds[#]() as a base rate. Each additional fragment reduces the healing interval by 0.25 seconds, down to a minimum of 1 second with many fragments.\
\
[#](8B0000)Fragments are permanently bound to your inventory. They can only be removed on death.[#]()\
\
[#](4A0080)A blessing... or a curse?[#]()
The Hand of Death requires advanced materials:

- [#](8B0000)Runic Sentient Scythe[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Demon Forged Steel[#]()

- Significant [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]()\
\
This is an end-game weapon requiring mastery of both Vitaemancy and Malum systems. Consult the recipe for exact requirements.
Demonic weapon with lifesteal and an execute mechanic. Requires Malum.

When an enemy falls below [#](8B0000)15%%[#]() health, the Hand of Death can instantly execute them:

- Triggers on your next hit

- Bypasses remaining health

- Full soul and spirit drops\
\
This makes the weapon devastating against high-health targets and bosses.

The Hand of Death retains all features from the [#](8B0000)Runic Sentient Scythe[#]():

- [#](4A0080)+30%% attack speed[#]()

- Full Spiritus scaling

- Malum spirit harvesting

- All sentient weapon effects\
\
[#](8B0000)+14 bonus base damage[#]() over the Runic Sentient Scythe, on top of lifesteal and execute, makes this the highest-damage melee weapon Animus ships.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Requires Malum to be installed.[#]()

The [#](8B0000)Hand of Death[#]() is the final evolution of the Runic Sentient Scythe. Forged with demon steel and infused with deathly power, this weapon executes weakened foes and heals its wielder through the lifeforce of the slain.\
\
[#](4A0080)It combines every feature of the Runic Sentient Scythe with lifesteal and an execute mechanic.[#]()

Every strike with the Hand of Death heals you for [#](8B0000)20%%[#]() of the damage dealt:

- Minimum heal of 1 health

- Works on all damage types

- Stacks with other healing

- No cooldown\
\
[#](2E8B57)Combined with the weapon's high damage, this provides substantial sustain in prolonged fights.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.key_binding.de: A mystical key that lets allies draw from your Anima reserves.
book.animusnv.guide.items.key_binding.in: A mystical key bound to a blood mage's [#](8B0000)Anima[#](). Its primary purpose is to share your [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() with allies. Place a [#](8B0000)Simple Key[#]() in a [#](B8860B)Tier 1[#]() Ara Vitae with 1,500 EV to create one.
book.animusnv.guide.items.key_binding.sh:
To share your [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() with another player:

- Bind the key to yourself (right-click)

- Give the bound key to a friend

- Your friend holds it in their offhand

- Any items they bind will draw from your Anima\
\
This powers your allies' sigils and bound tools without them needing their own EV infrastructure.
book.animusnv.guide.items.key_binding.st:
Consider these cooperative approaches:

- Designate one player as the EV generator

- Share keys with combat-focused teammates

- Power expensive rituals from a friend's network

- Let new players use advanced sigils immediately\
\
[#](4A0080)The key to unlocking cooperation in the sanguine arts.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.key_binding.us: Right-click while holding the key to bind it to your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](). Hold it in your offhand while binding items to use the key owner's network. It can also be equipped in the Curios "key" slot for the same effect.
book.animusnv.guide.items.living_armor_a: Sentient Armor evolves through Ars Nouveau spellcasting. Requires Ars Nouveau.

Levels 1-3 each add +5%% spell damage. By level 3, you deal 15%% more damage with all Ars Nouveau spells.\
\
Level 4 grants [#](8B0000)Mana Regeneration[#]() for 4 seconds on every spell cast, helping you recover mana faster.\
\
Level 5 is peak performance: +25%% spell damage, [#](8B0000)Spell Damage III[#]() for 5 seconds on cast, and 20%% mana cost refund.\
\
[#](B8860B)Total:[#]() 75 points for all levels.

Sentient Armor adapts to your magical practices. When you cast Ars Nouveau glyph-based magic, your armor learns and evolves, unlocking the [#](8B0000)Source Attunement[#]() upgrade path designed for source-wielding mages.\
\
[#](4A0080)Cast Ars Nouveau spells while wearing Sentient Armor to gain experience. The armor attunes to the flow of Source energy, growing stronger with each glyph you cast.[#]()

The Source Attunement upgrade tree provides five levels:\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 1:[#]() +5%% Spell Damage (5 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 2:[#]() +10%% Spell Damage (10 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 3:[#]() +15%% Spell Damage (15 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 4:[#]() +20%% Spell Damage, Mana Regen buff for 4s (20 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 5:[#]() +25%% Spell Damage, -20%% Mana Cost, Spell Damage III buff for 5s (25 points)

Stack Spell Damage III with Ars Nouveau's native damage buffs. Level 4 Mana Regen helps with sustained casting, and Level 5's 20%% mana refund makes expensive spells more viable.\
\
To maximize XP gain:

- Create longer, more complex spells

- Cast frequently while exploring

- Each glyph counts toward XP\
\
[#](2E8B57)XP is only granted while wearing Sentient Armor. Requires Ars Nouveau to be installed.[#]()

Every Ars Nouveau spell you cast grants XP to your Sentient Armor based on its complexity:\
\
Base XP (5) x Number of Glyphs\
\
[#](2E8B57)Example: A spell with 6 glyphs grants 5 x 6 = 30 XP[#]()\
\
More complex spells with many glyphs level your armor faster. Experiment with elaborate spell combinations to maximize progression.
book.animusnv.guide.items.living_armor_s: Sentient Armor evolves through Iron's Spells casting. Requires Iron's Spells.

Levels 1-2 reduce mana cost of spells when cast. At level 2, you save 10%% mana on every spell, stacking with other mana reduction effects.\
\
Levels 3-4 apply cooldown reduction. At level 4, spells recharge 10%% faster, letting you cast more often.\
\
Level 5 grants [#](8B0000)Resistance I[#]() for 2 seconds every time you begin casting, providing a defensive boost while channeling.

Sentient Armor evolves with you, and now it can grow stronger through spellcasting. Every spell you cast grants experience to your Sentient Armor, unlocking the [#](8B0000)Arcane Channeling[#]() upgrade path for Iron's Spellbooks practitioners.\
\
[#](4A0080)Wear Sentient Armor while casting spells. The armor learns from your magical prowess and adapts accordingly.[#]()

The Arcane Channeling upgrade tree provides five levels:\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 1:[#]() -5%% Mana Cost (5 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 2:[#]() -10%% Mana Cost (10 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 3:[#]() -5%% Cooldown (15 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 4:[#]() -10%% Cooldown (20 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Level 5:[#]() Resistance on Cast (25 points)\
\
[#](B8860B)Total:[#]() 75 points for all levels.

Arcane Channeling works well with:

- [#](8B0000)Blood-Infused Spellbook[#](): stack mana cost reductions

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of Crimson Will[#](): damage boost plus mana efficiency

- [#](8B0000)Sanguine Scrolls[#](): cast from scrolls while gaining XP\
\
To maximize XP: cast higher-level spells, seek rare and legendary spells, and cast frequently while exploring.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The armor gains XP from any spell, including those cast with EV. Requires Iron's Spellbooks to be installed.[#]()

Every spell you cast grants XP to your Sentient Armor:\
\
Base XP (10) x Spell Level x Rarity Multiplier\
\
Rarity Multipliers:

- Common: x1.0

- Uncommon: x1.5

- Rare: x2.0

- Epic: x3.0

- Legendary: x5.0\
\
[#](2E8B57)Example: A level 3 Rare spell grants 10 x 3 x 2.0 = 60 XP[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.mob_soul.descr: A portable container preserving a captured entity's complete state.
book.animusnv.guide.items.mob_soul.intro: A container holding the essence of a captured creature. Created by the [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Phantom Chain[#](), this item preserves an entity's complete state: health, equipment, custom names, and AI.
book.animusnv.guide.items.mob_soul.name: Mob Soul
book.animusnv.guide.items.mob_soul.usage:
Right-click on a block to release the captured entity at that location. The [#](8B0000)Mob Soul[#]() is consumed when the entity is released.\
\
All preserved data is restored:

- Entity type and health

- Equipment and inventory

- Custom names

- AI state and attributes\
\
[#](4A0080)Souls bound to your will.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.name: Items
book.animusnv.guide.items.runic_sentient:
The Runic Sentient Scythe is crafted at the [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() using:

- [#](8B0000)Sentient Scythe[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Malum Spirit Components[#]()

- [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]()\
\
The crafting process infuses Malum's spirit magic into the Vitaemancy weapon. Consult the recipe for exact requirements.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Requires Malum to be installed.[#]()
A faster Sentient Scythe with Malum spirit harvesting. Requires Malum.

When [#](8B0000)Malum[#]() is installed, killing mobs with this scythe harvests their spirits directly:

- Spirits drop with native Malum-scythe behaviour

- Works with all spirit types

- No additional soul data required

- Compatible with spirit pouches\
\
This makes it an excellent tool for both Spiritus farming and Malum spirit collection.

The [#](8B0000)Runic Sentient Scythe[#]() combines the demonic power of the Sentient Scythe with runic enhancements and Malum soul harvesting. This deadly weapon attacks [#](8B0000)30%% faster[#]() than its predecessor while reaping souls for the spirit altar.\
\
[#](4A0080)Like the Sentient Scythe, this weapon scales with Spiritus in the chunk. It inherits all Spiritus effects while adding Malum's spirit harvesting capabilities.[#]()

The runic modifications grant a [#](8B0000)30%% faster attack speed[#]() compared to the base Sentient Scythe. This allows for more rapid strikes and better Spiritus generation through combat.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The faster attack speed synergizes well with Malum's soul harvesting, allowing you to reap more spirits per encounter.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.sentient_shiel: A demonic shield with 4x durability and Spiritus-aspected blocking effects.

A demonic shield infused with [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#](), forged in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](). It boasts 4x the durability of a normal shield (1,344 vs 336) and grants special effects when blocking based on the type of Spiritus available to you.

While equipped in your main or offhand, the Sentient Shield increases the amount of [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() you gain from all sources by [#](2E8B57)+30%%[#]().\
\
[#](4A0080)A shield that hungers for more.[#]()

The shield automatically detects your highest [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() type and adapts:

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus:[#]() Standard blocking

- [#](4A0080)Invictus:[#]() Increased knockback resistance

- [#](2E8B57)Ruina:[#]() Attackers take damage

- [#](B8860B)Vindicta:[#]() Reflect damage back at attackers
book.animusnv.guide.items.spears.bound.t: The [#](8B0000)Bound Javelin[#]() is a soul-bound weapon with two modes. While deactivated, it behaves like a diamond javelin. Sneak + right-click to toggle its activated state.
book.animusnv.guide.items.spears.bound_a:
When activated, the Bound Javelin costs [#](4A0080)50 EV[#]() per attack or throw, and gains:

- AOE melee damage (5 block radius)

- Enemies near an Ara Vitae are sacrificed (instant kill + EV to altar)

- Unbreakable and fireproof\
\
[#](4A0080)A capstone weapon for Vitaemancy.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.items.spears.descrip: Throwable javelins in iron, diamond, and soul-bound variants.
book.animusnv.guide.items.spears.diamond: The [#](8B0000)Diamond Javelin[#]() offers higher damage and durability than iron, but functions identically. A worthy upgrade for those who can afford it.
book.animusnv.guide.items.spears.intro.t: Roman-style throwable javelins. Hold right-click to charge, then release to throw. Javelins deal area-of-effect damage where they land, making them effective against clustered enemies.
book.animusnv.guide.items.spears.iron.te: The [#](8B0000)Iron Javelin[#]() is the basic variant, with serviceable damage and durability for its cost. Supports enchantments such as Sharpness and Looting.
book.animusnv.guide.items.spears.name: Javelins
book.animusnv.guide.name: Codex Animus
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.animal_lurin:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 5,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh:[#]() 1,000 EV (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Refresh Time:[#]() 400 ticks (20 seconds)\
\
Spawns peaceful mobs randomly within a 4-8 block radius of the ritual stone.\
\
[#](B8860B)Mob Types:[#]() All peaceful creatures: Creature, Ambient, Water Creature, and Water Ambient categories.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Useful for repopulating areas after a catastrophe or seeding a new animal farm without hunting.[#]()
Spawns passive mobs around the ritual stone.

You call forth peaceful creatures from the ether. The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Animal Luring[#]() spawns passive mobs in the area around the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), useful for populating farms or seeding the world with life.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
[#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.culling.boss:
With sufficient [#](4A0080)Spiritus Nihilum[#](), even boss entities bow to the culling.

- Requires 99+ [#](4A0080)Spiritus Nihilum[#]() in the area

- Incurs additional EV cost (configurable)

- Makes otherwise-invulnerable bosses vulnerable\
\
Entities tagged [#](8B0000)animusnv:disallow_culling[#]() are protected from this ritual regardless of [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() levels.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.culling.cost:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 50,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh:[#]() 75 EV per entity\
[#](B8860B)Refresh Time:[#]() 25 ticks\
\
[#](B8860B)Effect Range:[#]() 21x21x10 blocks (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Horizontal:[#]() 10 blocks radius\
[#](B8860B)Vertical:[#]() 10 blocks upward from one block above the ritual stone\
[#](B8860B)Altar Range:[#]() Searches 11x21x11 for an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]().\
\
EV per kill varies by entity type and is datapack-customizable. Works on all non-boss entities by default.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.culling.desc: Destroys all living things within range, harvesting their life force.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.culling.intr:
A ritual of absolute dominion over life and death. The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Culling[#]() silently destroys all living things within its domain, channeling their life force into your [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]().\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner [Dusk][#]().
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.culling.mult: [#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.culling.name: Ritual of Culling
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.culling.will:
The ritual generates [#](4A0080)Spiritus Nihilum[#]() from kills at a 3%% chance per cycle, up to 100 [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() in the area.\
\
If configured, the ritual can also destroy [#](8B0000)Primed TNT[#]() entities, making it a potent defensive measure against explosive threats.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.entropy.appl:
This ritual excels at:

- Trash disposal for unwanted items

- Converting excess mob drops into building material

- Generating cobblestone from renewable farm output

- Clearing accumulated junk from storage\
\
[#](2E8B57)Pair with a mob farm for a steady cobblestone supply at minimal EV cost.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.entropy.cost:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 1,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh:[#]() 1 EV per item\
[#](B8860B)Refresh Time:[#]() 1 tick\
\
Place a chest one block above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). The ritual converts items in the chest to cobblestone at a rate of one item per tick.\
\
Cobblestone itself is not converted.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.entropy.desc: Reduces all items in a chest to cobblestone.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.entropy.intr:
All matter yearns to return to its most basic form. The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Entropy[#]() obliges, converting any items in a chest directly above it into cobblestone.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.entropy.mult: [#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.entropy.name: Ritual of Entropy
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.luna.costs.t:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 1,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh:[#]() 1 EV per block harvested\
[#](B8860B)Refresh Time:[#]() 5 ticks\
\
[#](B8860B)Horizontal Range:[#]() 32 blocks (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Vertical Range:[#]() 64 blocks (configurable, -1 for world bottom)\
\
Harvests any light-emitting block. If no chest is present, items drop at the stone.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Pair with the Ritual of Sol for an automated cycle of light placement and reclamation.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.luna.descrip: Harvests all light-emitting blocks within range.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.luna.intro.t:
The counterpart to the [#](4A0080)Ritual of Sol[#](). Where Sol banishes darkness, Luna harvests the light. This ritual collects all light-emitting blocks within its range and stores them in a chest above the ritual stone.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.luna.mechani:
Place a chest (or any block with item storage) directly above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). Every 5 ticks, the ritual attempts to:

- Find a light-emitting block (light level > 0)

- Harvest the block

- Store it in the chest (or drop at the stone if no chest)

- Consume EV for the operation
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.luna.multibl: [#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.luna.name: Ritual of Luna
The ritual uses a center-outward search to find light sources. It starts at the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), searches downward only, and expands in square rings. Each column is scanned from top to bottom, prioritizing nearby lights before distant ones.\
\
Up to 1,024 positions are processed per tick, and the search resumes where it left off between ticks.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.name: Rituals
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.natures_leac:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 3,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh:[#]() 10 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh Time:[#]() 80 ticks (configurable), dropping to 16 as [#](4A0080)Spiritus Ruina[#]() builds up\
\
[#](B8860B)Effect Range:[#]() 8 blocks radius, expandable to 32 with the Ritual Tinkerer\
[#](B8860B)Altar Range:[#]() 32 blocks horizontal, 10 blocks vertical\
\
Consumes 1-3 plants per cycle, generating 50 EV (configurable) per plant consumed. The altar location is cached for performance.
Drains the life from plants to fill your Ara Vitae.

You drain the life force from the green world itself. The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Nature's Leach[#]() scans for plant matter within its range and consumes it, converting organic energy into [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() for your [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]().\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
[#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()

This ritual generates [#](4A0080)Spiritus Ruina[#]() as it consumes plants.

- 0.5 to 1.5 [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() per plant consumed

- Maximum of 100 [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() in the area\
\
Note that more [#](4A0080)Spiritus Ruina[#]() in the area speeds the ritual up. It feeds its own supply as it eats, so it winds itself up the longer it runs.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Pair with an automated tree farm for a reliable, passive source of EV.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.nolite_ignem:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 5,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Per Fire:[#]() 10 EV per fire extinguished\
[#](B8860B)Range:[#]() 64 blocks (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Interval:[#]() Every second

The ritual extinguishes both regular fire and [#](8B0000)soul fire[#]() within a spherical range, not a cube.\
\
If your [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() runs low, the ritual will extinguish as many fires as it can afford before pausing.\
\
[#](2E8B57)An excellent safeguard for wooden builds, libraries, or any structure vulnerable to flame.[#]()
Continuously extinguishes all fires within range.

[#](4A0080)Nolite Ignem[#](), Do Not Burn. This ritual continuously extinguishes all fires within its range, protecting your constructions from accidental or intentional destruction by flame.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
[#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 50,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Upkeep:[#]() 100 EV per tick (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Range:[#]() 3 chunk radius (configurable)\
\
The ritual maintains chunk loading in a square area around itself. Chunks unload immediately if EV runs out.
Keeps chunks loaded even without players nearby.

The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Persistence[#]() forces the world to remain aware of its surroundings, keeping chunks loaded even when no players are nearby. Essential for automation and remote bases.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner [Dusk][#]().
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

A radius of 3 means a 7x7 chunk area, 49 chunks total.\
\
Chunks remain loaded even across server restarts, so long as the ritual is active and [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() continues to flow.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Pair with a reliable EV generation system such as the Ritual of Nature's Leach to ensure your automation never goes dark.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.relentless_t:
The ritual places fluid source blocks, letting Minecraft physics handle the natural flow.\
\
Fluid is only placed in air, replaceable blocks, or flowing fluid of the same type. The search pattern starts directly below the ritual and expands outward, skipping positions already filled.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Pair with the Ritual of Siphon to move entire bodies of fluid from one location to another.[#]()
Extracts fluid from a tank above and places it into the world.

The inverse of the [#](4A0080)Ritual of Siphon[#](). Where Siphon drains the world below, Relentless Tides extracts fluid from a tank above and places it into the world. Create lakes, flood caves, or fill moats with any fluid you desire.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner [Dusk][#]().
[#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()

Place any fluid container directly above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 5,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Per Bucket:[#]() 50 EV (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Range:[#]() 32 blocks horizontal, 128 blocks deep (configurable)
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.reparare.des: Repairs damaged items stored in a chest above the ritual.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.reparare.int:
The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Reparare[#]() mends damaged items stored in an inventory above the ritual stone. Place a chest directly above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() and items within will slowly be restored to full durability.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.reparare.mec:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 5,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Cost:[#]() Per durability point repaired (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Repair Rate:[#]() 20%% of max durability per cycle\
[#](B8860B)Interval:[#]() Every 5 seconds (configurable)
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.reparare.mul: [#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.reparare.set:
Place any container with item capability directly above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
Items tagged with [#](8B0000)animusnv:disallow_repair[#]() will be skipped by the ritual.\
\
[#](2E8B57)A passive, hands-free way to keep your best tools in fighting shape. Simply toss them in a chest and let blood mend what blood has broken.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.ritual_arcan:
EV costs scale with spell rarity:

- [#](8B0000)Common:[#]() 5,000 EV

- [#](8B0000)Uncommon:[#]() 10,000 EV

- [#](8B0000)Rare:[#]() 25,000 EV

- [#](8B0000)Epic:[#]() 50,000 EV

- [#](8B0000)Legendary:[#]() 100,000 EV\
\
Upgrade cost formula: Base cost x current spell level.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Example: Upgrading a Rare spell from level 2 to 3 costs 25,000 x 2 = 50,000 EV.[#]()
Learn and upgrade spells by consuming scrolls through ritual power. Requires Iron's Spells.

The [#](8B0000)Ritual of Arcane Mastery[#]() bridges the ritual system with Iron's Spells learning mechanics. This ritual can teach you new spells or upgrade existing ones by consuming scrolls placed in nearby chests.\
\
[#](4A0080)Place spell scrolls in chests within 5 blocks of the Master Ritual Stone. The ritual automatically processes scrolls, teaching you new spells or upgrading ones you already know.[#]()

The ritual searches for [#](8B0000)Iron's Spells Scrolls[#]() in chests within a 5-block radius (horizontal and vertical).\
\
If you do not know the spell: consumes the scroll, teaches you the spell at level 1, costs EV based on spell rarity.\
\
If you already know the spell: consumes the scroll, upgrades spell level by +1, EV cost = base cost x current level.

Build the ritual pattern, activate with [#](8B0000)10,000 EV[#](), then place chests within 5 blocks and fill them with spell scrolls.\
\
The ritual checks every 2 seconds, processes one scroll at a time, emits smoke if no scrolls found, and enchantment particles on success.\
\
Rune pattern: 8 Dusk Runes and 8 Air Runes arranged in inner, middle, and outer rings around the Master Ritual Stone.

Group common spells together and keep high-value scrolls separate. Monitor your EV levels and use activation crystals to start and stop.\
\
For bulk processing, fill multiple chests with scrolls. The ritual processes continuously. Check back periodically.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The ritual respects spell max levels. You cannot upgrade beyond a spell's natural maximum. Requires Iron's Spellbooks to be installed.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.ritual_flora:
[#](8B0000)Activation:[#]() 10,000 EV\
\
[#](4A0080)Upkeep:[#]() 50 EV per flower (configurable)\
\
[#](B8860B)Range:[#]() 8 blocks (configurable)\
\
[#](8B0000)Interval:[#]() Every second
Doubles Botania flower mana generation through blood sacrifice. Requires Botania.

All mana-generating flowers in range tick twice per second, effectively doubling their output.\
\
Mana Spreaders in range are also accelerated to 2x speed using temporal dominance.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Plan your flower garden layout within the ritual's range for maximum efficiency. Requires Botania to be installed.[#]()

The [#](8B0000)Ritual of Floral Supremacy[#]() supercharges nearby Botania mana-generating flowers, doubling their production rate; the same effect they would get from enchanted soil.\
\
[#](4A0080)Nature's bloom feeds on sacrifice. The flowers respond to the pulse of Essentia Vitae flowing through the ritual stones, accelerating their natural mana generation.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.serenity.cos:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 10,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Upkeep:[#]() 50 EV per tick (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Range:[#]() 48 blocks (configurable)\
\
Hostile mob spawning is completely prevented within the ritual's spherical range.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.serenity.des: Creates a zone that prevents hostile mob spawning.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.serenity.int:
The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Serenity[#]() creates a zone of peace where hostile creatures cannot spawn. Perfect for protecting your base without relying on torches or other lighting.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner [Dusk][#]().
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.serenity.mul: [#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.serenity.not:
The ritual does not remove mobs that are already present. It only prevents new spawns from occurring.\
\
Multiple rituals can overlap to cover larger areas.\
\
[#](2E8B57)An elegant alternative to flooding your base with light sources. Let the ambient darkness remain for atmosphere while blood keeps you safe.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.siphon.behav:
The search pattern starts directly below the ritual and expands outward in rings.\
\
Extracted fluid blocks are replaced with [#](8B0000)Antilife Block[#]() by default (configurable). Smoke particles appear when the tank is full or no fluid is found.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Pair with the Ritual of Relentless Tides to relocate entire bodies of fluid from one location to another.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.siphon.descr: Extracts fluids from the world below into a tank above.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.siphon.intro:
The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Siphon[#]() extracts fluids from the world below and deposits them into a tank above. It searches from center outward, draining oceans, lava lakes, or any fluid source it encounters.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner [Dusk][#]().
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.siphon.multi: [#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.siphon.name: Ritual of Siphon
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.siphon.setup:
Place any fluid container directly above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 5,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Per Bucket:[#]() 50 EV (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Range:[#]() 32 blocks horizontal, 128 blocks deep (configurable)
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.sol.blood_li:
If you place a [#](8B0000)Sigil of Blood Light[#]() in the chest, the ritual will place [#](8B0000)Blood Lights[#]() without consuming the sigil. This allows for infinite blood light placement using only EV.\
\
[#](2E8B57)An incredibly efficient way to light vast areas with a single sigil and a steady supply of Essentia Vitae.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.sol.costs.te:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 1,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh:[#]() 1 EV per block placed\
[#](B8860B)Refresh Time:[#]() 5 ticks\
\
[#](B8860B)Horizontal Range:[#]() 32 blocks (configurable)\
[#](B8860B)Vertical Range:[#]() 64 blocks (configurable, -1 for world bottom)\
\
Requires dark spots (light level < 8) with solid ground below to place blocks.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.sol.descript: Automatically places light sources in dark areas.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.sol.intro.te:
Banish the darkness. The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Sol[#]() automatically places light sources in dark areas, preventing mob spawns and illuminating your surroundings. Place light-emitting blocks in a chest above the ritual.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.sol.mechanic:
The ritual requires a chest (or any block with item storage) placed directly above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). Every 5 ticks, it attempts to:

- Find a valid block item from the chest

- Search for a dark spot (light level < 8) with solid ground below

- Place the block

- Consume EV for the operation
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.sol.multiblo: [#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.sol.name: Ritual of Sol
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.sol.search.t:
The ritual searches from center outward, starting at the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() and expanding in square rings. It scans downward only, processing each column from top to bottom. Up to 64 positions are checked per tick.\
\
The search resumes where it left off between ticks, ensuring efficient coverage.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.steadfast_he:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 20,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh:[#]() 100 EV per player\
[#](B8860B)Refresh Time:[#]() 60 ticks (3 seconds, configurable)\
\
[#](B8860B)Effect Range:[#]() 128 blocks radius (configurable)\
\
Each cycle extends and strengthens the [#](4A0080)Absorption[#]() effect on all nearby players.
Grants scaling Absorption to nearby players, with remote buffing via orbs of vitae.

Fortify your allies. The [#](4A0080)Ritual of the Steadfast Heart[#]() grants escalating [#](4A0080)Absorption[#]() effects to all nearby players, providing extra health that regenerates over time. It can also buff players remotely through bound orbs of vitae.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
[#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()

Place a chest directly above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() and fill it with bound orbs of vitae of any tier.\
\
The ritual will buff the bound player regardless of their location, even across dimensions, as long as they are online.

- Each player is only buffed once per cycle

- Works with any tier orb of vitae

- EV cost applies per player buffed

The [#](4A0080)Absorption[#]() effect stacks duration and amplifier over time.

- Duration increases each cycle

- Max duration: 30,000 ticks

- Max amplifier: 4 (10 absorption hearts, configurable)\
\
The ritual also generates [#](4A0080)Spiritus Invictus[#]() up to a maximum of 100 in the area.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.unmaking.cos:
[#](B8860B)Activation:[#]() 3,000 EV\
[#](B8860B)Refresh:[#]() 0 EV (one-time use)\
[#](B8860B)Refresh Time:[#]() 20 ticks\
\
[#](B8860B)Effect Range:[#]() 5x5x5 blocks around the ritual\
\
Throw books and enchanted items near the ritual. It deactivates automatically after extracting enchantments.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.unmaking.des: Extracts and duplicates enchantments from items onto books.
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.unmaking.int:
Break the bonds of magic. The [#](4A0080)Ritual of Unmaking[#]() extracts enchantments from items and places them onto books, allowing you to repurpose or duplicate enchantments at will.\
\
Construct this circle using a [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.unmaking.mec:
For regular enchanted items, the ritual extracts all enchantments to separate enchanted books. The item is left unenchanted.\
\
For enchanted books with multiple enchantments, each enchantment is split and duplicated. You receive two copies of each at a reduced level (level -1, minimum 1).\
\
Items enhanced by the [#](4A0080)Imperfect Ritual of Enhancement[#]() are ignored by default (configurable).\
\
[#](2E8B57)An invaluable tool for recycling enchantments from unwanted loot or duplicating rare enchantments from books.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.rituals.unmaking.mul: [#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.name: Sigils
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_builder:
The sigil draws a minimal amount of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per block placed. Even modest reserves will sustain extended building sessions.\
\
Perfect for large construction projects, terraforming, and creative building endeavors where mortal hands simply cannot keep pace with ambition.
Accelerates block placement to supernatural speeds.

The sigil dramatically accelerates your block placement speed, allowing you to construct at a pace far beyond mortal hands.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Simply carry it in your inventory or hotbar while placing blocks. The sigil works passively. No activation required.[#]()

You craft this sigil within an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() by combining a [#](8B0000)Reagent: Builder[#]() with a [#](B8860B)Tabula Robur[#](). The reagent must first be forged in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]().\
\
When the array completes its working, the [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Fast Builder[#]() emerges, a tool for those who would reshape the world at unnatural speed.
The sigil excels at relocating villagers, preserving rare mobs, creating living displays, setting up mob farms, and ensuring safe transport of dangerous creatures.\
\
Release a captured entity by right-clicking the [#](8B0000)Mob Soul[#]() on any block.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Bosses and other high-HP entities resist capture entirely.[#]()
Captures living creatures into portable Mob Soul containers.

Forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() from a [#](8B0000)Reagent: Chains[#]() and a [#](B8860B)Tabula Animata[#](), this sigil captures the essence of living creatures. It binds entities into [#](8B0000)Mob Soul[#]() items, preserving their form and state for later release.

Right-click on an entity to attempt capture. The creature is drawn into a [#](8B0000)Mob Soul[#](), preserving:

- Health and active effects

- Equipment and inventory

- Custom names

- AI state\
\
The [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() cost varies by entity.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_consump: Corrupts the world with spreading AntiLife. Use with extreme caution.

Forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() from a [#](8B0000)Reagent: Consumption[#]() and a [#](B8860B)Tabula Animata[#](), this dire sigil corrupts the world itself. Right-click to convert nearby blocks into [#](8B0000)AntiLife[#](), a spreading, devouring substance that consumes all it touches.

Each activation costs [#](4A0080)25 EV[#]() per block converted (configurable) and affects blocks within an 8-block range (configurable).\
\
[#](8B0000)AntiLife cannot be reversed.[#]() Once the corruption takes hold, there is no undoing what you have wrought. Plan your targets with care.

Certain blocks resist the corruption entirely. Anything tagged [#](4A0080)animusnv:disallow_antilife[#]() cannot be converted:

- Barrier and Bedrock

- Command blocks

- Structure blocks

- End portal frames

- AntiLife itself
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_crimson:
Each spell cast with the sigil active consumes:\
\
[#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae:[#]()

- Configurable per mana point (default: 50 EV)

- Scales with spell level

- Example: 10-level spell = 500 EV\
\
[#](4A0080)Spiritus:[#]()

- 5 Spiritus per cast (if available)

- Consumes from Anima

- Optional. Sigil works without Spiritus
Empowers spellcasting with Essentia Vitae and Spiritus. Requires Iron's Spells.

Crafted in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() by combining a [#](8B0000)Reagent: Fist[#]() with a [#](B8860B)Tabula Animata[#](), this sigil empowers your spellcasting with both Essentia Vitae and Spiritus. While active it raises spell power and summon damage, scaling with the raw Spiritus stored in your Anima.\
\
[#](4A0080)Right-click to activate. Every spell you cast while it is active consumes EV and briefly empowers you.[#]()

[#](8B0000)Base Bonus:[#]() +30%% spell power and summon damage\
\
[#](4A0080)Spiritus Scaling:[#]()

- Scales up to +50%% total at 4096 Spiritus

- Uses Spiritus from your Anima

- Works with 0 Spiritus (base 30%% only)\
\
The bonus is applied only during spell casting and removed immediately after.

[#](8B0000)Active[#]() (glowing red icon):

- Consumes resources per spell

- Boosts spell power and summon damage

- Shows dynamic power bonus in tooltip\
\
[#](4A0080)Inactive[#]() (gray icon):

- No resource consumption

- No power boost

- Right-click to toggle\
\
The sigil must be bound to your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() to activate. Keep it in any inventory slot. Deactivate between fights to conserve EV.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Requires Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks to be installed.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_equival: An equal-exchange sigil for rapid block replacement across surfaces.

Replaced blocks drop with [#](8B0000)Silk Touch[#]() behaviour.\
\
Replacements are [#](4A0080)plane-locked[#](). Only blocks on the same plane as the clicked face (floor, wall, or ceiling) are affected.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Replacements happen gradually over time to reduce server strain.[#]()

An equal-exchange sigil for rapid block replacement. You select a palette of blocks, then swap connected blocks of the same type within a configurable radius. The foundation of all alchemical transformation begins here.

Right-click a block to begin replacement. The sigil flood-fills connected blocks of the same type along the clicked face's plane, replacing them with random blocks from your selection.\
\
Scroll while sneaking to adjust the radius (1-32 blocks). Each replacement costs [#](4A0080)EV[#]() per block (configurable).

Build your replacement palette:

- Sneak + Right-click a block to add it to your selection

- Sneak + Right-click air to clear the entire selection

- You may select up to 20 different block types\
\
Only blocks present in your inventory (survival) or currently selected (creative) will be used as replacements.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_free_so:
When you would die with this sigil in your inventory, it automatically activates if you have sufficient [#](4A0080)EV[#](). Upon returning from spectator mode, you receive 5 hearts of healing.\
\
A [#](4A0080)60-second cooldown[#]() (configurable) separates death prevention triggers.
A reusable Totem of Undying that grants spectator mode and prevents death.

A protective sigil that grants temporary [#](4A0080)spectator mode[#]() and can prevent death outright. It functions as a reusable Totem of Undying, powered by your reserves of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().

Right-click to enter spectator mode for [#](4A0080)10 seconds[#]() (configurable), at a cost of [#](4A0080)5,000 EV[#]() (configurable). You may scout areas, pass through walls, and escape danger freely.\
\
You are teleported back to your original position before the effect ends.

[#](2E8B57)You are teleported back to your original position 0.5 seconds before spectator mode ends, preventing wall-clipping exploits.[#]()\
\
[#](4A0080)The soul slips free of death's grasp... for a price.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_heavenl: Lifts enemies skyward then slams them earthward with lethal force.

A devastating sigil that calls down heaven's judgment upon your enemies. Those caught within its reach are lifted skyward before being slammed back to earth with deadly force. The cost is [#](4A0080)1,000 EV[#]() per activation, with a range of 16 blocks.

Right-click to activate. All enemies within range receive [#](4A0080)Levitation II[#]() for 3 seconds with an additional upward velocity boost. Once the effect ends, they plummet.\
\
Targets also receive the [#](8B0000)Heavy Heart[#]() effect for 2 seconds, preventing flight of any kind.

Flying creatures or those already at great height receive stronger downward velocity based on their distance from the ground. The higher they are, the harder they fall.\
\
[#](4A0080)What goes up must come down... violently.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_leach.d: Drains nearby plant life to automatically restore your hunger.

The sigil devours logs, leaves, saplings, flowers, crops, grass, kelp, seagrass, vines, and most bonemealable plants.\
\
Each block consumed generates [#](4A0080)Spiritus Ruina[#]() (0.3-0.8 per block) in the local chunk.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The hungry mage need never farm again.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_leach.i: Forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() from a [#](8B0000)Reagent: Leach[#]() and a [#](B8860B)Tabula Robur[#](), this toggleable sigil drains the life from nature itself to sustain your hunger. The green world withers so that you might thrive.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_leach.u:
Sneak + right-click to toggle the sigil on or off. While active and you can eat, the sigil consumes plant matter at a cost of [#](4A0080)5 EV[#]() per consumption:

- First searches your inventory for plant items

- Then scans nearby blocks within 8 blocks

- Destroys consumable blocks and restores 1-3 hunger + saturation
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_monk.ab:
Right-click to toggle. While active, you gain:

- +10 unarmed damage with knockback

- Netherite + Efficiency V mining with bare hands

- On kill: Resistance II (5s) + Regeneration (2s)

- Applies Spiritus Snare II (2s) on hit

- Fall damage immunity (25 EV per fall)
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_monk.co:
The sigil draws from your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() for various actions:

- [#](8B0000)5 EV[#]() per unarmed attack

- [#](8B0000)5 EV[#]() per block mined

- [#](8B0000)25 EV[#]() per fall damage negated

- [#](8B0000)50 EV[#]() per projectile caught\
\
Ensure your Anima has sufficient reserves before extended combat or mining.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_monk.de: Channels demonic power into devastating unarmed combat and bare-hand mining.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_monk.ex:
If your attack would leave an enemy below the execute threshold (equal to your bonus damage percentage), you perform an [#](8B0000)Execute[#]():

- Instant kill

- +200 EV added to your Anima

- -5 Spiritus consumed from inventory\
\
Requires at least 5 Spiritus to trigger. A burst of soul particles marks the kill.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_monk.in: A curio sigil that channels demonic power into devastating unarmed combat. You master the way of the fist, empowered by [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#](). Craft the [#](8B0000)Reagent of the Fist[#]() in a Tabula Vitae, then combine it with a [#](B8860B)Tabula Robur[#]() in an Alchemy Array.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_monk.pr:
Incoming projectiles can be caught when your main hand is empty or holding a catchable projectile:

- Arrows (regular and spectral)

- Tridents

- Firework rockets\
\
Caught projectiles go to your main hand, or stack if holding the same type.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_monk.sp:
Your unarmed attacks deal [#](4A0080)bonus damage[#]() equal to a percentage of the target's maximum health, scaling with [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]():

- [#](B8860B)1 Spiritus:[#]() +1%% max HP damage

- [#](B8860B)4,096 Spiritus:[#]() +15%% max HP damage\
\
All Spiritus types (Raw, Ruina, etc.) are combined for this calculation.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_remediu: Continuously purges harmful status effects while active.
A toggleable sigil that continuously cleanses your body of harmful afflictions. While active, negative status effects are purged at a steady cost of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().

Only harmful effects are removed. Beneficial effects such as Regeneration or Strength remain untouched.\
\
The cost scales with the number of afflictions. Cleansing 3 effects simultaneously costs 150 EV.\
\
[#](4A0080)Purity through sacrifice.[#]()

Right-click to toggle the sigil on or off. While active, all harmful effects are automatically removed once per second, at a cost of [#](4A0080)50 EV[#]() per effect removed.\
\
The sigil deactivates if your reserves are exhausted.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_reparar: Passively repairs all damaged equipment in your inventory over time.
A toggleable sigil that mends your equipment over time. While active, damaged items throughout your inventory slowly repair themselves at the cost of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().

Items tagged with [#](4A0080)animusnv:disallow_repair[#]() cannot be restored by this sigil. The repair rate per interval is also configurable.\
\
[#](4A0080)Blood mends what time breaks.[#]()

Right-click to toggle on or off. The sigil periodically scans all inventory slots, armor, and offhand for damaged items and repairs them.\
\
The [#](4A0080)EV[#]() cost per durability point is configurable. The sigil deactivates if your reserves are exhausted.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_storm.c:
The fish loot spawning can be configured:

- Minimum rolls: 2 (default)

- Maximum rolls: 5 (default)

- Set both to 0 to disable\
\
[#](2E8B57)This sigil excels at fishing, combat, and demonstrating your mastery of the elements.[#]()
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_storm.d: Calls down targeted lightning strikes. Also useful for fishing.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_storm.e:
When you target water, the lightning yields fishing loot (2-5 rolls by default). Loot spawns 1 second after the strike to prevent items from burning.\
\
During rain, the strike deals area damage to entities within 5 blocks of the impact point.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_storm.i: Forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() from a [#](8B0000)Reagent: Storm[#]() and a [#](B8860B)Tabula Robur[#](), this sigil harnesses the fury of the heavens. Right-click to call down lightning at a targeted location up to 64 blocks away, at a cost of [#](4A0080)500 EV[#]() per strike.
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_tempora:
Blocks tagged with [#](4A0080)animusnv:disallow_acceleration[#]() cannot be accelerated.\
\
The sigil does not stack with GAG's Temporal Pouch, Time in a Bottle, or JustDireThings' Time Wand.\
\
[#](4A0080)Time bends to the will of blood.[#]()
Accelerates block entities up to 32x speed through stacking time dilation.

A sigil that accelerates time for block entities. Furnaces smelt faster, crops grow more quickly, and machines process at up to 32x normal speed, all bent to your will through the expenditure of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().

Each tier costs more [#](4A0080)EV[#]():

- [#](B8860B)Level 1:[#]() 2x speed, 1,000 EV

- [#](B8860B)Level 2:[#]() 4x speed, 2,000 EV

- [#](B8860B)Level 3:[#]() 8x speed, 4,000 EV

- [#](B8860B)Level 4:[#]() 16x speed, 8,000 EV

- [#](B8860B)Level 5:[#]() 32x speed, 16,000 EV\
\
Refreshing the timer at max level costs 15,000 EV.

Sneak + right-click on a block entity to activate. Each activation lasts 30 seconds and increases the speed level. Repeated clicks on the same block stack the acceleration up to [#](B8860B)32x speed[#]().
book.animusnv.guide.sigils.sigil_transpo:
At a cost of [#](4A0080)5,000 EV[#]() per transposition:

- Right-click a block to select it as the source (the sigil activates)

- Right-click another block's face to move the source block adjacent to it

- Right-click air to clear your selection\
\
The sigil chunk-loads the source area during transposition for safety.
Relocates blocks without breaking them and teleports entities to Teleposers.

At a cost of [#](4A0080)2,000 EV[#]() per teleportation:

- Sneak + right-click a [#](8B0000)Teleposer[#]() to bind its location

- Attack an entity to teleport it 1 block above the bound Teleposer\
\
[#](2E8B57)Players can only be teleported if they are sneaking. The Teleposer must still exist at the bound location.[#]()

Forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() from a [#](8B0000)Reagent: Transposition[#]() and a [#](B8860B)Tabula Spiritus[#](), this sigil moves blocks through space without breaking them, and transports entities to bound Teleposers.

The sigil respects chunk protection (FTB Chunks, etc.) and cannot move blocks tagged [#](4A0080)forge:relocation_not_supported[#](). The destination must be air.\
\
Perfect for moving complex machinery, filled chests, spawners, and tile entities , or for teleporting mobs to farms and creating trap systems.
